pixelOfficeCompanion.sensors.typing.description: Emit events when you type or go idle in the editor.

pixelOfficeCompanion.sensors.ai.description: Emit events when an AI chat request starts, streams, or ends.

pixelOfficeCompanion.sensors.tests.description: Emit events when a test task starts or finishes.

pixelOfficeCompanion.sensors.debug.description: Emit events when a debug session starts, ends, or steps.

pixelOfficeCompanion.sensors.window.description: Emit events when the editor window gains or loses focus, or when the active file changes.

pixelOfficeCompanion.sensors.files.description: Emit events when files are created, deleted, or renamed.

pixelOfficeCompanion.sensors.terminal.description: Emit events when a terminal shell command finishes. Requires shell integration to be active.
